summary: Bipartisan Policy Center argues for preserving E‑Rate, opposing sunset or narrowing, and stresses connectivity’s role beyond screen time. BPC argues that E‑Rate should retain its presumption that on‑campus activities serve an educational purpose, oppose any sunset or narrowing of the program, and distinguish student screen time from instructional and administrative uses of connectivity.
